scripts.setup: npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed:local
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local -c worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p web/functions/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name mhm-sms --branch production --cwd web
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c worker/wrangler.toml --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c worker/wrangler.toml --env production
scripts.deploy:web:preview: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name mhm-sms --branch preview --cwd web
scripts.db:migrate:demo: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c worker/wrangler.toml --env demo
scripts.db:seed:demo: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote -c worker/wrangler.toml --env demo --file=seed/demo.sql
scripts.deploy:demo: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c worker/wrangler.toml --env demo
